nodes.name: AllocationDonut.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module styling the AllocationDonut chart component: donut SVG geometry, center label/value/percent overlay, and a scrollable legend list with hover/active states, collapsing to a single column on narrow viewports.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties from the design token system (--color-*, --space-*, --radius-*) for theme consistency, and a media query to switch the chart+legend layout from row to column below 640px.

nodes.name: Badge.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module defining the small inline Badge component's base style plus three semantic color variants (positive, neutral, warning) using tinted backgrounds via color-mix.

nodes.name: Button.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the shared Button component, covering three sizes (sm/md/lg) and three visual variants (primary, secondary, ghost) plus disabled and hover states.

nodes.name: EmptyState.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the EmptyState placeholder component: centered dashed-border container with icon, title, description, and action button slots.

nodes.name: FundSignal.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the FundSignal indicator: a circular arc gauge in three sizes with positive/negative color states, plus an expandable popout panel showing a period toggle and sparkline chart.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines a rotated SVG arc gauge with an absolutely-positioned animated popout (fadeIn keyframes) for the expanded detail view.

nodes.name: HoldingsTable.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the HoldingsTable component: search box, sortable column headers, row hover states, numeric/gain-loss cell alignment and coloring, and an empty-table message.

nodes.name: Modal.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the shared Modal dialog: blurred backdrop with fade-in animation, centered card with header/close-button/body regions and scrollable content.

nodes.name: Skeleton.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module providing a shimmering loading-skeleton animation plus layout styles for a table-shaped skeleton placeholder used while holdings data loads.

nodes.name: ThemeToggle.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the fixed-position circular ThemeToggle button in the top-right corner, with hover scale and focus-visible outline states.
